errors.text_span: representing different activation functions: Squared Exponential (navy blue, solid line), Tanh (blue, solid line), ELU (light purple, solid line), and LLaMA-2-chat-7B (pink, dashed line)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly categorizes LLaMA-2-chat-7B as an activation function. The other three lines represent models using different activation functions, but LLaMA-2-chat-7B is a baseline model itself, not an activation function.
For the navy blue line (Squared Exponential), the accuracy at 250 demonstrations is approximately 55.5, not 57. The peak of the line never reaches 57.

errors.text_span: The blue line begins at around 47 at 0 demonstrations
errors.evidence: The blue line (Tanh) starts at an accuracy of approximately 48, not 47. The data point is clearly above the midpoint between 45 and 50.
The light purple line (ELU) remains stable at an accuracy of approximately 46 across all demonstrations. It never reaches 47.5.
The description fails to mention that the 'Squared Exponential', 'Tanh', and 'ELU' lines all have circle markers on their data points.
